meta.title: Hartwell & Okafor | Family, wills and probate law, Islington
meta.description: A small Islington law practice for divorce, children arrangements, wills, lasting powers of attorney and probate. Fixed fees and a free 20 minute first call.

rationale: Sage green in one hue, from the tinted page to the near black green ink, gives a calm, steady feel for people who arrive at a hard moment, without the coldness of blue or the clichés of navy and gold. Fraunces headlines with a quiet sans body feel personal and serious. The statement hero, a letter from the partners, a featured family law service and a question and answer process speak to worried clients before asking them to book.

props.statement: Divorce, wills and probate are hard enough. We explain each step plainly, agree the fee with you first, and take the first twenty minutes on us.
props.detail: Two partners and a paralegal, working from Islington. Call us before you decide anything.

props.label: What we do
props.title: Three areas, done carefully
props.intro: We keep our work to the things we know well. Where we can, we quote a fixed fee before we start.

featured.name: Family law
featured.description: Divorce, separation and arrangements for children. We help you work out what you need, what is fair and what to do first, then guide you through it at a pace you can manage. We aim for agreement where it is possible and stand firm where it is not.

props.label: How it works
props.title: What you might be wondering, and what happens

pairs.ask: I do not even know where to start.
pairs.answer: That is normal. Book the free 20 minute call and tell us what is going on. You do not need documents or the right words.

pairs.ask: How much is this going to cost?
pairs.answer: Before any work begins we tell you the fee in writing. Where the work allows it, the fee is fixed, so there is no running meter.

pairs.ask: What do you need from me?
pairs.answer: We tell you exactly which papers to find, and we ask for them in small lists rather than all at once.

pairs.ask: Who will I be speaking to?
pairs.answer: One of the two partners handles your matter, with our paralegal helping on the paperwork. You know who to call.

props.label: About us
paragraphs: Most people who contact us have never needed a solicitor before. They are tired, often anxious, and usually worried about what this will cost.
We set up Hartwell & Okafor to be the practice we would want to call ourselves: small, direct and clear about money. You speak to the partners, not to a call centre.
If we are not the right people to help, we will say so on the first call, and you will have lost nothing.
props.name: Clare Hartwell and Tunde Okafor

items.q: Is the first call really free?
items.a: Yes. It lasts 20 minutes, there is no obligation, and we will tell you honestly whether and how we can help.
Where we can, yes. We will tell you at the start whether your matter can be done for a fixed fee and what that fee covers.

items.q: Which matters do you take on?
items.a: Family law (divorce, separation and arrangements for children), wills and lasting powers of attorney, and probate.

items.q: Can I bring someone with me?
items.a: Of course. Many people find it easier with a friend or relative beside them.
